findings.title: Agent 365 BYO MCP governance flow and schema evaluation
findings.qualifying_date_basis: The page footer shows Last updated on 2026-07-30, which is inside the cutoff window.
findings.factual_summary: Microsoft's Agent Tools documentation describes a centralized registry for AI-powered tools and MCP servers, a BYO MCP server registration flow with admin review and approval, runtime blocking, declared-tool snapshots, supported client surfaces, and Defender advanced hunting observability. The page also documents a local MCP evaluation command that combines deterministic checks with optional coding-agent semantic scoring while warning that schema data is handed to a local coding agent when semantic scoring is enabled.
findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: This is a concrete governance pattern for MCP-as-practice: developer registration, admin approval, server-level block controls, tool-schema transparency, security telemetry, and explicit data-handling notices for agent-scored tool evaluation. Local wiki relevance is strongest for governed MCP onboarding, approval evidence, tool-call observability, and the boundary between deterministic validation and agent-mediated semantic checks.

findings.title: UiPath late-July releases add MCP OAuth, audit, queues, and autonomous test execution controls
findings.visible_date: Release catalog includes July 30, 2026 and July 31, 2026 entries in the July 16, 2026 - July 31, 2026 release timeframe.
findings.qualifying_date_basis: The release catalog lists Automation Ops on July 30, Maestro on July 31, Orchestrator on July 30 and July 31, and Test Manager on July 30, all inside the cutoff window.
findings.factual_summary: UiPath's late-July release notes include a Bring Your Own Model-only governance toggle in AI Trust Layer policies, AI Trust Layer audit records for Unstructured and Complex Documents extraction inputs and outputs, MCP OAuth public preview with built-in OAuth proxy, resource-bound tokens and callback-domain allow lists, queue-triggered Maestro flows, live execution trace for single nodes in the VS Code extension, and Test Manager autonomous execution and exploration with model selection, secure credential references, live remote-control viewing, and human controls.
findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: The update reinforces several practice-level patterns: agent model-routing governance, audit capture for AI processing, governed MCP authorization, queue-backed workflow state, live execution traces, and autonomous testing with explicit human supervision. Local wiki relevance is strongest for harness architecture, approval boundaries, audit logs, and AI-assisted verification workflows.
